title: 0/1 Knapsack
description:
You have a bag with capacity W and n items. Item i has a weight and a value. Choose a set of items, each at most once, whose total weight is at most W and whose total value is as large as possible.

Input format
Line 1: n and W separated by a space.
Next n lines: weight and value of each item, separated by a space.

Output format
One integer: the maximum total value.
hints: For each item you have two choices: take it or leave it. Which smaller sub-problems does each choice lead to?
Let dp[w] be the best value with capacity w using the items considered so far. Processing a new item (wt, val): dp[w] = max(dp[w], dp[w - wt] + val).
Loop the capacity w from W DOWN to wt. Looping upwards would let the same item be taken repeatedly (that is the unbounded knapsack, a different problem).

examples.explanation: Take the items of weight 20 and 30 for a value of 220.
The first item is too heavy; only the second fits.
